description: This file defines the DuplexPipeStream class, a custom Stream implementation that wraps around a PipeReader and PipeWriter from System.IO.Pipelines, providing asynchronous and synchronous read/write capabilities over a duplex pipe, including support for APM pattern conversions.

classes.name: DuplexPipeStream
classes.description: A custom Stream implementation that wraps a duplex pipe, enabling read/write operations with support for async, sync, and APM patterns.

classes.name: TaskToApm
classes.description: A static internal class providing utility methods to convert Tasks to the APM (Begin/End) pattern, including an internal TaskAsyncResult class.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the stream, completing the underlying PipeReader and PipeWriter.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes the stream, completing the PipeReader and PipeWriter asynchronously.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Synchronously reads data into a buffer.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads data into a buffer.

methods.name: BeginRead
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous read operation using the APM pattern.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Throws NotSupportedException; seeking is not supported.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Throws NotSupportedException; setting length is not supported.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Synchronously writes data from a buffer.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes data from a buffer.

methods.name: BeginWrite
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous write operation using the APM pattern.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Copies data asynchronously to a destination stream.
